publication.title: RDF-ANALYTICS: Interactive Analytics over RDF Knowledge Graphs
publication.version: EDBT2023 publisher report; verified page-preserving reader copy

source_reading.scope: All four pages: concrete interaction model/system, product-domain path/aggregation example, screenshots, efficiency scope, feature comparison, preliminary task outcomes and conclusion. Read from the validated page-preserving copy; not a full-report equivalence claim about another publication.

adjudication.basis: RDF-ANALYTICS implements iterative faceted exploration and analytic-query construction over actual RDF KG instance relations. Applicable choices/counts guide users toward answerable queries; grouping/measurement controls and reloading results enable HAVING/nested analytical restrictions. A preliminary ten-person task evaluation is reported, with limited protocol detail and no interface comparator.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.design: Single-interface preliminary evaluation, concise help page, no prior training; ten defined tasks
studies.results: Task outcomes73% success,2% partial,25% failure. Usefulness50% very useful/50% useful.
limitations: Demographics/recruitment, exact outcome-observation denominator, task timing and questionnaire details are not provided. Ten tasks multiplied by ten users is not automatically an explicitly reported100-observation denominator. Larger evaluation is future work.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.

limitations: Feature coverage is not a controlled comparative user study; source characterizations remain report-specific.

descriptions.interaction: Explore nested facets/property paths, apply numeric intervals, derive date parts, choose grouping and measurement functions, inspect table/pie results and reload answers as a new faceted dataset for further restrictions or nested queries.
descriptions.guidance: Data-applicable class/property choices and counts at each state constrain construction to answerable queries; counts and result feedback preserve context.
descriptions.visualisation: ["Nested facet panels", "Analytical answer table", "Pie-chart result plot", "Reloaded result facets"]
descriptions.backend: Actual RDF knowledge graphs, including non-star-schema paths
